changelog: Added FlowBot, an optional text-only AI assistant with ChatGPT sign-in on Windows. Requires an installed Codex runtime; it cannot browse or perform NetSuite actions.
Bundled a 27-topic NS Flow knowledge base, with relevant guide excerpts and expandable Sources inside chat. No live records or app activity are automatically shared.
Fixed Bulk Transfer to use the requesting browser's timezone for Target Record dates and report a saved adjacent-date difference as a notice instead of a false failure.
Added a theme-aware chat overlay that opens and expands without shifting the app, with separate user and assistant bubbles and a subtle send-button glow.
Improved FlowBot replies with clickable links, basic formatting, paragraph spacing, and animated thinking dots inside the reply bubble.
Added automatic chat-session recovery after idle expiry or an app restart, preserving the open-page conversation and draft without replaying interrupted replies.
Kept the Bulk Transfer action labeled Transfer when reapplying guardrails.
Fixed compact headers to keep only the NS Flow icon as space decreases, while preserving scrollable navigation and preventing logo overlap.
